generation_parents.algorithm: Use a distance-scaled capacity tie-break: primary ordering keeps d_current − 0.60·d_depot, but within a near-tie band away from the depot, compare candidates using a small capacity-fit term (rest_capacity minus candidate demand) normalized by local distance to prefer good-capacity matches, with a tiny demand tie-break.

declared_hypothesis: The capacity term may address a different failure mode than angle and produce a measurable instance-level effect.
